description: Media apps for UmbraDesktop. A Media Manager that opens the media library in desktop windows, one folder per window, with dragging between them, cut, copy and paste, files from your computer, background transfers and undo; and an Image Editor that crops, adjusts, marks up, redacts and resizes image…
Official .NET client for the BAPP Auto API: authentication, entity CRUD, document views, tasks and file uploads.
